resources.name: papers
resources.description: One row per selected paper: first-public date and type, identifiers, venue, pages, a verbatim sentence with page, what changed (en/ko), OpenAlex id and citation count with the date read, selection rules, source status.

resources.name: edges
resources.description: Citation lineage among selected papers; kind = OA (OpenAlex referenced_works), original (seen in the citing paper's reference list), notion (textbook attribution without a confirmed citation).

resources.name: winter_title_phrases
resources.description: OpenAlex records per year with a phrase in the title, and per 10,000 of all records (read 2026-11-03).

resources.name: winter_attendance
resources.description: Conference attendance 1984–2025; source column names the AI Index 2019 sheet or Our World in Data (AI Index 2026, CC BY).

resources.name: winter_neurips_accepted
resources.description: Papers per year on proceedings.neurips.cc, counted 2026-11-03.

resources.name: awards
resources.description: Turing Award laureates (Wikidata, CC0) and 2024 Nobel laureates (Nobel API, CC0) linked to papers in the list.
